evidenceAssessment.notice: Incomplete lap-leader charts. Displayed ages are observed boundaries only; uncovered Grand Prix events can change the oldest, youngest and national records. Missing leadership is unknown, not zero.
evidenceAssessment.missingEvidence: Complete event-bound lap-leader charts for every excluded event, with canonical driver identities.

coverage.note: Ages use the separately accepted 784-driver birthdate evidence set. Drivers outside it remain unresolved, not age zero. Championship ages use the first F1DB clinching flag bound to the verified season champion. Race-leading ages are provisional observed boundaries from complete published lap charts; uncovered events are explicitly excluded and may change the result.
